description: Eaux usées - Réseau de collecte - Angers Loire Métropole is a dataset listed in Angers Loire Métropole - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Angers Loire Métropole. Description du réseau de collecte des eaux usées. ECOUNORM écoulement normal - DIAMETRE diamètre du collecteur - MATERIAU Matériau du collecteur - LONGUEUR Longueur - ZAMONT Altitude amont - ZAVAL Altitude aval - DATEPOSE Date de pose du collecteur - EXPLOIT Exploitant du collecteur. Coverage: Angers Loire Métropole. The portal files it under Réseaux, Energies. Its keywords are assainissement, eaux-usees, eau. The portal shows 37,836 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-angers-fr-portal.
